# JVM Yore

> JVM Yore is a three-person senior software studio from the Czech Republic (Prague and remote). We build frontend web apps (Angular, React, Vue), .NET backends, native iOS and Android apps (Swift, Kotlin), and LLM-based AI automation.

JVM Yore, s.r.o. (Company ID 29633443) is a Czech limited company registered with the Municipal Court in Prague, Section C, Insert 449138. The team is Janis (managing director, client delivery), Vít and Michael (full-stack engineers). Work is remote and async-first; new enquiries get a reply within 24 hours at hello@jvm-yore.com.

## Services

- [Frontend development](https://jvm-yore.com/#services): fast, accessible web applications in Angular, React or Vue
- [Backend systems](https://jvm-yore.com/#services): APIs, microservices and cloud infrastructure, primarily on .NET (REST and gRPC)
- [Mobile applications](https://jvm-yore.com/#services): native iOS and Android apps in Swift and Kotlin
- [AI automation](https://jvm-yore.com/#services): LLM integrations, agents and workflow automation

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://jvm-yore.com/pricing): consulting from €100/hour; the whole team on a monthly retainer from €17,900/month; fixed-scope projects quoted individually. JVM Yore is not VAT-registered, so no VAT is added.
